rust_summary: small client and server helpers for the WebAssembly services: a mod message to the server from a hook with a shared view of the game, client-only sounds, the local player's items, turned sprite quads and a server-side food setter.
doc_summary: `native_net_send_to_server_shared(channel, data)` is `native_net_send_to_server` for hooks that hold only a shared view of the game (the screen key and mouse hooks). `native_queue_local_sound(sound, at, volume, pitch)` queues a sound for this client alone (`at` of None is a UI sound with no attenuation) that plays when the next frame starts. `native_local_player_stacks()` lists the local player's stacks as the client sees them. `native_player_set_food(uuid, food, saturation)` sets a player's food level and saturation on the server tick. Nothing changes unless a mod calls them. Bundles need fragment @API:fr_s1_services@.
